title: Soul-Audit Wraith
kicker: a cold memory predator that makes care feel like an unpaid balance
hook: a cold memory predator that makes care feel like an unpaid balance

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A blue-white skeletal auditor drifts inside a torn hood, ledger-light spilling from a dead chest medallion while spectral papers curl around one arm.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: A predator made of policy, hunting where debt, ward-failure, and fear overlap. The original person wanted release from a debt that taught them to collect others, and that single unpaid wanting is the only crack in the ledger.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: A hard combat puzzle A memory choice A chance to refuse accounting language

affordances: A chance to refuse accounting language
